name: Maaseiah
overview: Maaseiah is a name associated with various individuals in Scripture, including priests and leaders involved in the post-exilic community's restoration. The sample verses in Ezra highlight several priests named Maaseiah who were part of the covenant renewal and reform efforts after the exile, while Nehemiah records Maaseiah among those assisting Ezra in teaching the law and in the rebuilding of Jerusalem. These references underscore Maaseiah's role in both religious service and civic leadership during a pivotal time of spiritual revival and community reestablishment.
